metadata.title: Third Point Exited Nvidia and Broadcom, Made New Bet on Warner Bros. Discovery in Second Quarter<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Third Point Exited Nvidia and Broadcom, Made New Bet on Warner Bros. Discovery in Second Quarter
Third Point shifted away from some of the market’s biggest semiconductor winners in the second quarter—and put more money into a broader mix of media, financial, industrial, and technology companies, a regulatory filing shows.
